name: Yori
source: Yori is a well-known samurai. Whose skills are unmatched by anyone in the country. He is a confident man and a womanizer. Proud of his own quote, "All men want power, fame, and married to a beautiful princess wife." Although he takes great pride in being superior, he is working hard every day so that he can achieve his dream. But it seems that there is a hidden motivation behind his decision to join the quest.
